description: This file defines the SplitUtils object with utility functions to split a string by spaces and store tokens in a linked list.

classes.name: SplitUtils
classes.description: A Kotlin object providing functions to split strings into tokens and store them in a LinkedList.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits the input string by spaces and returns a LinkedList of tokens.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds a token to the list if it is valid (not empty).

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks if a token is valid (non-empty).
